**Subject:** Re: SSO support

Hi [Name],

Thanks for asking. We don't support SSO today. We're planning SAML SSO for our Enterprise plan, and it's currently scheduled for Q1 2027. It won't be included in the Team plan.

Team accounts can still sign in with email and password. If SSO is a requirement for you, I can pass your details to us so we can talk about Enterprise when it launches.

Best,
The Larkfield team
